title: Chapter 134 Tuition Fee: 100,000
content:
Chapter 134 Tuition Fee: 100,000

"Master Architect, my territory has been completely destroyed. Now I need the protection of the city wall. So, how much do you think is appropriate?"

"One hour, 10,000 gold coins?" Xiao Laoteng asked tentatively.

"You are robbing me. This is simply asking for my life!" Wang Shuo's face changed and he exclaimed.

Of course, Wang Shuo was pretending to be all this.

In his advanced backpack, there are more than 6 million energy crystals.

In the Dahuai domain, he is definitely the undisputed number one in financial strength.

"9,000 gold coins?" Xiao Laoteng sniffed and said again.

"1,000 gold coins." Wang Shuo said decisively.

"I am a mid-level architect, and I am only worth this price?" Xiao Laoteng's mouth was crooked with anger.

If I hadn't thought that if I didn't make some money, this business trip would be a big loss.

He even wanted to turn around and leave.

Wang Shuo looked at it and seemed that he had pressed too hard?

He didn't know the market price.

"Wait a minute." Wang Shuo pondered for a while, gritted his teeth and said: "How about this, I will give you 5,000 energy crystals directly, and you help me train 10 architects. What do you think?"

"Haha, goodbye!"

"How many do you want?" Wang Shuo was anxious.

"Do you know how to become an architect?" Xiao Laoteng laughed coldly in anger.

Wang Shuo shook his head, showing an expectant look: "I don't know!"

Xiao Laoteng waved his hand, showing a look like looking at a country boy, and said lightly: "Forget it, forget it, I'll tell you!"

"To become an architect, you must be a low-level life profession such as a mason or a carpenter. Only after you have mastered 4 related skills can you master the profession of architect."

"Of course, if you can find a senior architect and worship him as a teacher, or you can directly obtain the architect's job transfer certificate, these are ignored."

"However, it is more difficult to obtain an architect's job transfer certificate than to worship a senior architect as a teacher."

Wang Shuo was stunned when he heard it, and then, Wang Shuo showed a charming smile and looked straight at Xiao Laoteng, which made him hairy.

"Don't think of me, I will not accept apprentices, and I am not qualified to accept apprentices."

Seeing the other party's firm attitude, Wang Shuo sighed helplessly.

"There are 11 masons in my territory now. You can teach us how to draw defensive runes first. As for how much it will cost, you can name a price!"

Xiao Laoteng thought about it and just gave some pointers. Drawing defensive runes was not difficult.

But he still pretended to be very embarrassed. He paced a few steps, touched his chin with his hand, and said in a deep voice: "I usually charge by the hour. Your class is a large class. The price is 100,000 gold coins."

Then he added: "Let me make it clear first. If your qualifications are too poor and you can't learn, I can only teach you for one day at most."

When Wang Shuo heard this, he frowned and was worried. Is this reliable?

But he thought again that if he really learned it, he would have another way to make money in the future.

Seeing Wang Shuo's tangled expression, Xiao Laoteng was afraid that this kid would give up and refuse to learn.

So he explained: "Under normal circumstances, a mason only needs 4 hours to learn."

"I have a request, teach at least 10!"

"5!"

"This is 100,000 gold coins, at least 9!"

"8!"

"Good deal!"

Xiao Laoteng stamped his feet, thinking that it was not good, as if he had said too much.

Since he had agreed, there was nothing to regret.

Afterwards, Wang Shuo summoned all the masons and Xiao Laoteng began to teach them.

In a huge tent, Xiao Laoteng sat at the head, and a pot of tea had already been brewed on the wooden table in front of him.

He cleared his throat, glanced at everyone, and began to speak: "The method of drawing this defensive rune is actually very simple, just..."

After listening to Xiao Laoteng's explanation for a while, Wang Shuo finally realized why he could not successfully draw the rune.

It turned out that the pen used for drawing must be a special rune pen.

High-level beast hair is needed, preferably the wolf boss, that is, the small tuft of tail hair on the tail of the wolf that has evolved into a demon beast.

In addition, the pen body needs to be infused with energy crystals.

This is just a rune pen.

When drawing runes, you must infuse mental power into the tip of the pen, just like releasing skills.

There are also requirements for the stroke sequence of the rune pattern.

…

Xiao Laoteng has been talking for almost an hour, and the tea has been changed twice.

“Do you understand everything?” Xiao Laoteng was very excited and intoxicated after speaking.

“Do you understand it?!”

The people below were a little afraid to answer.
